lesson.subtitle: Lesson 5 -- My Family
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 5 -- My Family
lesson.grammar_point: present simple third person (-s) + possessive adjectives my / his / her

listenings.text: Good afternoon. This is the school office. Tomorrow is a special day: the children have an English day at school. Classes start at eight and finish at three. Please send a small snack and one bottle of water. The parents' meeting is on Friday, at six in the evening. Thank you, and have a good afternoon.

Hi Ricardo, Paul here. You asked about my family. My wife is a teacher and she works at a school here in Miami. My son is fifteen years old and he plays baseball on Saturday. On Sunday we are together at home. Miami is good for families: the beach is near and the weekend is long. See you on Monday.

extra_audio.text: My wife and my daughter are at home. My daughter is ten years old. She studies at a bilingual school. She speaks English at school every day. On the weekend we are together.
